mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the peripheral nerve to the cord was most worthwhile: the planned cross-section distinguishes incoming sensory fibres from outgoing motor fibres and introduces the local circuits between them.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial myelinated-nerve construction was comparatively thin: the planned picture shows gaps in the wrapping but does not explain their significance.

surprise.text: The descending cortical command and local spinal route can influence the same final motor neurons, connecting the chapter's two routes.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the touch pathway's deep brain relay was left unnamed and unexplained, making that connection less informative.

continue.text: I would continue, especially to see how the spinal route produces a response and how it compares with the cortical route; the shared motor neuron made that comparison interesting.
